summary: xAI announced that Grok Build, its in-chat app-building feature, is now available on all plans across web, iOS and Android, with new capabilities including publishing to grok.me links, API access to Grok models from generated apps, remixing, custom domains, GitHub export, secrets storage and data connectors.

mechanisms.reason: Rolling the app-builder out to every plan and letting generated apps call Grok for chat, images and voice increases the surface generating API calls, though no volume figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: Turn on the SpaceXAI APIs for an app and it can call Grok for chat, images, and voice from inside its own code — no keys to create, paste, or rotate.

practices.reason: Engineering teams building on Grok now have concrete new interface points to wire up: per-app API toggles, GitHub export, custom domains, secrets storage and data connectors.
practices.quote: Custom domains. Point a domain you own at your app. Export to GitHub. Push the whole project to a repo and keep going in an editor, or in Grok Build for the terminal . Secrets. Store API keys for third-party services outside your app's code. Connectors. Pull in the data that matters to your business and turn it into live, filterable dashboards.
